ts = system.date.format(system.date.now(), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
	tsFile = system.date.format(system.date.now(), "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss")
	
	projectName = system.util.getProjectName()
	timezone = self.session.props.gateway.timezone
	gatewayAddress = self.session.props.gateway.address	
	
	# Try to extract the resolved wrapper path from:
	# === C:\...\wrapper.log ===
	resolvedPath = ""
	firstLine = logText.splitlines()[0] if logText else ""
	if firstLine.startswith("=== ") and firstLine.endswith(" ==="):
		resolvedPath = firstLine.replace("=== ", "").replace(" ===", "")
	
	header = []
	header.append("Kanoa Wrapper Log Export")
	header.append("Exported: {}".format(ts))
	header.append("Gateway Host: {}".format(timezone))
	header.append("Gateway Address: {}".format(gatewayAddress))
	header.append("Project: {}".format(projectName))
	header.append("InstallInfo: {}".format(diagnosticText))

	if resolvedPath: header.append("Resolved Path: {}".format(resolvedPath))
	header.append("-" * 60)
		
	exportText = "\n".join(header) + "\n\n" + logText
	fileName = "diagnosticLogs_{}.txt".format(tsFile)
	
	system.perspective.download(filename=fileName, data=exportText.encode("utf-8"), contentType="text/plain")
	
	return
